title: Statistically Optimal and Near Linear Time Hypothesis Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.30003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In hypothesis selection we are given $n$ distributions $q_1,\dots,q_n$ on a countable domain $\mathcal{X}$ and samples from an unknown distribution $p$. The goal is a distribution $q$ with $\mathrm{TV}(p,q)\le\alpha\min_i\mathrm{TV}(p,q_i)+\epsilon$. The factor $\alpha=2$ is optimal for algorithms using a number of samples from $p$ that is independent of $|\mathcal{X}|$, and in general only improper learners achieve it. We give a learner that achieves $\alpha=2$ with $O(\log(n/\delta)/\epsilon^2)$ samples of $p$, with probability at least $1-\delta$. This matches the sample complexity of Yatracos's factor-$3$ estimator, and it removes the logarithmic factors in the factor-$2$ bound of Bousquet et al. (FOCS 2021). translated_abstract: 在假设选择问题中，给定可数域 $\mathcal{X}$ 上的 $n$ 个分布 $q_1,\dots,q_n$，以及来自未知分布 $p$ 的样本。目标是找到一个分布 $q$，使得 $\mathrm{TV}(p,q)\le\alpha\min_i\mathrm{TV}(p,q_i)+\epsilon$。对于使用与 $|\mathcal{X}|$ 无关的来自 $p$ 的样本量的算法而言，因子 $\alpha=2$ 是最优的，且通常只有非真学习器才能达到该因子。我们给出了一个学习器，它以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率，使用 $O(\log(n/\delta)/\epsilon^2)$ 个来自 $p$ 的样本达到 $\alpha=2$。这与 Yatracos 因子-$3$ 估计器的样本复杂度相匹配，并去除了 Bousquet 等人（FOCS 2021）因子-$2$ 界中的对数因子。该学习器仅通过采样和逐点比较来访问 $q_i$。我们用预言机复杂度（即预言机调用次数）来衡量其运行时间。在期望意义下，它进行 $O((n\epsilon^{-2}+\epsilon^{-4}\log(1/\ldots$ 次预言机调用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种假设选择学习器，在期望意义下近线性运行时间、仅需 $O(\log(n/\delta)/\epsilon^2)$ 个样本即可达到统计最优的因子2近似，同时去除了Bousquet等人（FOCS 2021）因子2界中的对数因子。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hypothesis selection learner that achieves the statistically optimal factor of 2 with O(log(n/δ)/ε²) samples in near-linear expected running time, removing the logarithmic factors from the prior factor-2 bound of Bousquet et al. (FOCS 2021).
